name: Evereld
subtitle: Daily notes in your own files
promotionalText: Start with today's note. Write in Markdown, follow links between ideas, and browse your days without moving your files into a new database.
description:
Evereld is a Markdown notebook for iPhone and iPad, built around a simple habit: open today's note and start writing.

YOUR FILES, IN PLACE
Choose a folder of Markdown notes in Files. Evereld reads and edits those files where they already live. There is no account to create or proprietary note format to export.

A NOTE FOR EACH DAY
Use the calendar to revisit a day or create its note. Choose your daily-note folder, filename format, and a template with supported date and time expressions.

WRITE AND CONNECT
Edit Markdown with live formatting, follow links between notes, and find link targets as you type. Browse folders, bookmark frequently used notes, and search your collection.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Keep the writing area close at hand with file and calendar panels, native menus, and light and dark appearances.

Evereld works with plain Markdown files. It does not run third-party note-taking plugins or arbitrary template scripts.
betaDescription: Evereld is a Markdown notebook for iPhone and iPad centered on daily writing. Open a folder of Markdown files, write today's note, navigate dates with the calendar, browse and bookmark files, search notes, and follow links between them. Notes remain ordinary files in the folder you choose. No app account is required. This beta supports a limited set of date and time template expressions; it does not execute third-party plugins or arbitrary scripts. Please test using a disposable folder of notes.
whatToTest: Test opening a disposable Markdown folder, creating today's note, typing and saving, reopening the app, navigating the calendar, searching, bookmarking, and following note links. Check the new Evereld icon, name, and emerald accents in light and dark appearance. Report unexpected edits, missing saves, layout problems, or slow interactions. Please include the device model, iOS version, and steps to reproduce without including private note contents.
reviewNotesForNewBuild: No sign-in is required. Use a disposable folder containing one or more .md files in the Files app. On first launch, tap Choose Folder, select the folder, and configure daily notes using the built-in template. Open Today to create or edit a note; use the calendar and file panel to navigate. This release introduces the Evereld name, an original emerald-cut notebook icon, a matching launch image, and emerald interface accents to address the misleading branding identified in the previous beta review. The app is an independent Markdown editor and daily notebook.
